hotel.name: JW Marriott Resort Kaafu Atoll Island

verified_facts.text: The resort is on Hathaa Finolhu in Kaafu Atoll, Maldives.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hathaa Finolhu, Kaafu Atoll, Maldives, 02117

verified_facts.text: The resort is a 15-minute speedboat ride from Velana International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort is 15-minute speedboat ride away

verified_facts.text: The resort was designed by architect Cuneyt Bukulmez of Turkey-based Atolye4N.
verified_facts.excerpt: Envisioned by acclaimed architect Cuneyt Bukulmez of Turkey-based Atolye4N

verified_facts.text: The arrival jetty is inspired by the flight of the Maakana, the great grey heron.
verified_facts.excerpt: The arrival jetty, inspired by the graceful flight of the Maakana—the great grey heron

verified_facts.text: The villas draw inspiration from traditional Gedhoru island homes, with thatched kajan roofs and turquoise doors.
verified_facts.excerpt: draws inspiration from traditional ‘Gedhoru’ island homes, featuring thatched kajan roofs and signature turquoise doors

verified_facts.text: Every villa has a private pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: each villa feature a private pool, offering an exclusive escape surrounded by the beauty of the Maldives

verified_facts.text: The overwater villas have direct lagoon access and floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: each villa features direct access to the lagoon, a serene private pool, and floor-to-ceiling windows framing panoramic views

verified_facts.text: Villa bathrooms have both indoor and outdoor showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: The space features both indoor and outdoor showers

verified_facts.text: The Ocean Residence has its own spa treatment room, a personal gym and a water slide into the lagoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: A private dining room, pantry, and dedicated spa treatment room invite indulgent moments of connection and relaxation. From a personal gym to an exhilarating water slide into the turquoise lagoon

verified_facts.text: Guests are looked after by a Safeeru, a butler role rooted in the traditions of the Maldivian Sultanate era.
verified_facts.excerpt: A Safeeru embodies the timeless spirit of Maldivian hospitality, rooted in the traditions of the Sultanate era

verified_facts.text: Spa by JW is set over the water and has six treatment rooms, a steam room, sauna and jacuzzi.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set above the gentle waves, Spa by JW invites guests into a serene space of renewal. Featuring six treatment rooms, a steam room, sauna, jacuzzi

verified_facts.text: Spa by JW uses BABOR skincare, offered for the first time in the Maldives.
verified_facts.excerpt: treatments featuring BABOR’s precision skincare products—offered for the first time in the Maldives

verified_facts.text: The main pool is framed by the ocean and white sandy beach, with a lap pool and a kids' pool alongside.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our main pool, framed by the ocean and white sandy beach, offers a serene space to relax while enjoying light bites and refreshing drinks poolside. Adjacent, a dedicated lap pool lets guests stay active

verified_facts.text: The Family by JW Kids Club has a treehouse where kids can climb walls and swing from the ceiling.
verified_facts.excerpt: this enchanting space includes a whimsical treehouse where kids can climb walls, swing from the ceiling

verified_facts.text: There is a Splash Park for children's water play.
verified_facts.excerpt: The adventure continues at the vibrant Splash Park, where little ones can immerse themselves in colorful water play

verified_facts.text: The resort works with INVENA and MIT's Self Assembly Lab on an underwater structure to reduce beach erosion and create reef habitat.
verified_facts.excerpt: this initiative introduces a 30-meter-long underwater coastal structure, designed with the Self Assembly Lab at MIT. The structure will reduce wave impact, combat beach erosion

verified_facts.text: Destination dining includes private sandbank lunches and starlit dinners.
verified_facts.excerpt: indulge in our exclusive Destination Dining—from private sandbank lunches to starlit dinners

verified_facts.text: The resort has a Water Sports and Dive Center.
verified_facts.excerpt: embark on unforgettable island adventures through our Water Sports & Dive Center

verified_facts.text: The resort's restaurants use produce from its own island JW Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our seasonal Maldives oceanfront restaurant puts the spotlight on the fresh produce grown on the island in our own JW Garden

verified_facts.text: Nikkei is an overwater venue blending Japanese and Peruvian cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nikkei presents the bold fusion of Japanese precision and Peruvian soul. This overwater dining experience

verified_facts.text: Athiri, meaning shoreline in Dhivehi, is a parrilla grill house with ocean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Athiri, meaning “shoreline” in Dhivehi, brings island elegance to a refined parrilla grill house. Set against panoramic ocean views

verified_facts.text: Third-party transfers to the resort are not permitted.
verified_facts.excerpt: Third-party transfers are not permitted.

verified_facts.text: The resort is Green Globe certified.
verified_facts.excerpt: Green Globe Certified

verified_facts.text: Every villa offers direct access to the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: each of the villas at our beachfront resort in the Maldives offers direct access to the sea
